The new-comment composer: a mention-aware textarea, one picker per configured facet, and a send button. Starts as a pill when `collapsible`. Owns only its own draft state; posting is delegated to `onCreate`.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/comments/CommentComposer.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { CommentComposer } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/comments";
```

## Demos

No dedicated Storybook demo is available for this component yet.
